Oliver (partnerships): FYI CloudShelf asked if we can support a 3-week marketplace push (Aug 10-30). They project ~2.2M inference calls/day at peak and need a capacity+cost estimate for the reseller listing.

Jun (partner-success): They want both us-east and eu-west availability. Estimated split ~60% US / 40% EU, but hours may skew EU evenings. They warned traffic could have short spikes up to 2.5x.

Matt (eng-infra): What's the avg prompt/response sizes? I can rough out GPU-hours.

Oliver (partnerships): They provided: ~80 tokens prompt, ~40 tokens response (no streaming). So ~120 tokens/call.

Matt (eng-infra): Quick back-of-envelope:
```
calls = 2_200_000
tokens_per_call = 120
tokens_day = calls * tokens_per_call  # 264,000,000
tokens_per_gpu_hour = 60 * 3600  # 216,000 tokens/hour
gpu_hours_day = tokens_day / tokens_per_gpu_hour  # ~1222
peak_window_days = 21
total_gpu_hours = gpu_hours_day * peak_window_days  # ~25,660
``` 
So baseline ~1,225 GPU-hours/day needed; plan for short bursts up to ~2,450 GPU-hours/day if spikes hit 2x-2.5x.

Anya (eng-sre): EU note: our eu-west Dedicated pools are ~75% utilized already this quarter. If we need >2x EU bursts, we either: (A) route overflow to US (adds cross-region egress + latency), or (B) request temporary Dedicated increase (lead time ~72h and costlier).

Elaine (finance): Cost sketch using $2.25/GPU-hour reserved:
- Baseline total (~25.6k GPU-hrs) -> ~$57.7k
- If substantial on-demand bursting (~35% premium) -> up to ~$78k
Network egress: assuming 40% traffic EU and ~5 bytes/token compressed -> EU tokens/day ~105.6M -> ~528MB/day (~11GB over promo). Egress $s are negligible vs GPU but cross-region latency impacts SLOs.

Matt (eng-infra): Two caveats: (1) tokens/sec changes by model/precision. If CloudShelf picks a smaller quantized variant we could get 1.5-2x throughput; (2) p95 target will drive whether we can use high-throughput variants or must prefer lower-latency configs.

Jun (partner-success): CloudShelf's asks for p95 < 700ms if possible. They want a per-day estimate to show on the marketplace tile and confirmation we can advertise "regional SLOs".

Anya (eng-sre): p95 <700ms regionally at this scale is doable if EU baseline capacity is reserved. US-to-EU fallback will likely violate p95 for EU users during spikes. We should offer two tiers on the reseller page: "Regional SLO (recommended)" and "Best-effort fallback (lower SLO)".

Oliver (partnerships): Can infra produce a final recommended footprint (GPU-hours per region + burst plan) and a short blurb for the reseller page? They'll need conservative + optimistic cost ranges.

Matt (eng-infra): Action items:
- Run perf run for recommended model variant on staging to measure tokens/sec and p95 at 48h (job queued).
- Produce region breakdown with reserve vs overflow assumptions (ETA 24h) — I'll aim for US reserve ~750 GPU-hrs/day, EU reserve ~475 GPU-hrs/day as starting point.

Anya (eng-sre): I'll check if we can reallocate any Dedicated slack from other accounts and confirm lead time for temporary pool increases (ETA 24h).

Elaine (finance): I'll draft two cost scenarios (reserved-only / reserved+burst) and include recommended markup for reseller pricing. ETA 24h.

Jun (partner-success): I'll ask CloudShelf to provide expected hourly curve (do they expect lunchtime spikes, etc.) and whether they can shift some heavy hours to US primetime to smooth EU load.

Oliver (partnerships): Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT with CloudShelf + infra. I'll send calendar invite.

devops-bot: Perf job #5127 started; results in ~48h.

Matt (eng-infra): Will post perf numbers and updated GPU-hour table here when ready. :thumbsup:

Anya (eng-sre): Noted — I'll attach node-allocation and temp-scaling rules once confirmed.

Jun (partner-success): Thanks team. I'll update CloudShelf that we have ballpark numbers and will lock them in after perf results.

Oliver (partnerships): Appreciate it. Let's try to keep conservative estimates on the marketplace page. :eyes:
